data.readme:
---
name: dataclaw-sync
description: Incrementally sync AI conversation records to Obsidian. Use DataClaw to export conversations from AI Agents such as Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Kimi, Gemini CLI, and OpenClaw, convert them into Obsidian notes, and store them in the LabNotes vault. Supports incremental updates, processing only newly added sessions. Optionally upload to Hugging Face. Triggered when the user says "同步对话", "导出对话", "sync conversations", "对话存档到 Obsidian", or "/dataclaw-sync".
---

# DataClaw Sync

Incrementally export AI Agent conversation records and convert them into Obsidian notes.

## Prerequisite Check

```bash
command -v dataclaw >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "dataclaw: OK" || echo "NOT INSTALLED — run: pipx install dataclaw"
```

If not installed, run `pipx install dataclaw` (requires `brew install pipx` first).

## Supported Sources

claude, codex, gemini, kimi, opencode, openclaw, custom. AI IDEs such as Cursor are not supported.

## Workflow

### Step 1: Export Conversations

```bash
dataclaw export --no-push -o ~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl
```

- `--no-push` exports locally only, without uploading to HF
- `--source` filters sources: `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `kimi`, `opencode`, `openclaw`, `all` (default is all)
- Timeout set to 180s (takes time for a large number of sessions)

### Step 2: Incrementally Convert to Obsidian Notes

```bash
python3 ~/.claude/skills/dataclaw-sync/scripts/convert_to_obsidian.py
```

Script features:
- Reads `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` to skip already processed session_ids
- Writes new sessions into source-specific directories under `AI对话记录/{source}/` in the Obsidian vault
- Filename format: `{date} {title}.md`, with the title extracted from the first user message
- Each note includes frontmatter (source, project, model, date, tags)

Paths can be customized via environment variables (defaults are used if not set):

| Environment Variable | Description | Default Value |
|----------|------|--------|
| `DATACLAW_EXPORT` | Export file path | `~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl` |
| `DATACLAW_OBSIDIAN_DIR` | Obsidian notes directory | `~/Obsidian/LabNotes/AI对话记录` |
| `DATACLAW_CONVERTED_LOG` | Converted records file | `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` |

### Step 3: Confirm Results

Report to the user:
- How many new notes were added
- Distribution by source (claude/opencode/kimi, etc.)
- Note storage path

### Step 4 (Optional): Upload to Hugging Face

Execute only when the user explicitly requests an upload.

1. Confirm HF login: `hf auth login --token <TOKEN>`, and redact the token: `dataclaw config --redact "<TOKEN>"`
2. Set the repo: `dataclaw config --repo "username/dataset-name"`
3. PII review — ask the user for their full name and run the scan command:
 ```bash
   grep -i 'FULL_NAME' ~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl | head -10
   ```
4. Ask whether company names, client names, private URLs, etc., need to be redacted, and add them using `dataclaw config --redact "string"`
5. Execute confirmation: `dataclaw confirm --full-name "NAME" --attest-full-name "..." --attest-sensitive "..." --attest-manual-scan "..."`
6. Push after explicit user consent: `dataclaw export --publish-attestation "User explicitly approved publishing."`

## Configuration Management

Exclude projects: `dataclaw config --exclude "project1,project2"`
Redact strings: `dataclaw config --redact "secret"`
Redact usernames: `dataclaw config --redact-usernames "handle"`
View configuration: `dataclaw config`
View status: `dataclaw status`

## Key Paths

| Purpose | Path |
|------|------|
| Export file | `~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl` |
| Notes directory | `~/Obsidian/LabNotes/AI对话记录/` |
| Converted records | `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` |
| Conversion script | `~/.claude/skills/dataclaw-sync/scripts/convert_to_obsidian.py` |
| dataclaw configuration | `~/.dataclaw/config.json` |

# DataClaw Sync

将 AI Agent 对话记录增量导出并转换为 Obsidian 笔记。

## 前置检查

```bash
command -v dataclaw >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "dataclaw: OK" || echo "NOT INSTALLED — run: pipx install dataclaw"
```

若未安装，执行 `pipx install dataclaw`（需先 `brew install pipx`）。

## 支持的来源

claude、codex、gemini、kimi、opencode、openclaw、custom。不支持 Cursor 等 AI IDE。

## 工作流

### Step 1: 导出对话

```bash
dataclaw export --no-push -o ~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl
```

- `--no-push` 仅本地导出，不上传 HF
- `--source` 筛选来源：`claude`、`codex`、`gemini`、`kimi`、`opencode`、`openclaw`、`all`（默认 all）
- 超时设置 180s（大量会话时需要时间）

### Step 2: 增量转换为 Obsidian 笔记

```bash
python3 ~/.claude/skills/dataclaw-sync/scripts/convert_to_obsidian.py
```

脚本特性：
- 读取 `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` 跳过已处理的 session_id
- 新会话按来源分目录写入 Obsidian vault 的 `AI对话记录/{source}/`
- 文件名格式：`{日期} {标题}.md`，标题从首条 user 消息提取
- 每则笔记含 frontmatter（source、project、model、date、tags）

可通过环境变量自定义路径（不设则使用默认值）：

| 环境变量 | 说明 | 默认值 |
|----------|------|--------|
| `DATACLAW_EXPORT` | 导出文件路径 | `~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl` |
| `DATACLAW_OBSIDIAN_DIR` | Obsidian 笔记目录 | `~/Obsidian/LabNotes/AI对话记录` |
| `DATACLAW_CONVERTED_LOG` | 已转换记录文件 | `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` |

### Step 3: 确认结果

报告给用户：
- 新增了多少条笔记
- 各来源分布（claude/opencode/kimi 等）
- 笔记存放路径

### Step 4（可选）: 上传到 Hugging Face

仅在用户明确要求上传时执行。

1. 确认 HF 已登录：`hf auth login --token <TOKEN>`，并脱敏 token：`dataclaw config --redact "<TOKEN>"`
2. 设置 repo：`dataclaw config --repo "username/dataset-name"`
3. PII 审查 — 询问用户全名，运行扫描命令：
   ```bash
   grep -i 'FULL_NAME' ~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl | head -10
   ```
4. 询问是否有公司名、客户名、私有 URL 等需要脱敏，用 `dataclaw config --redact "string"` 添加
5. 执行确认：`dataclaw confirm --full-name "NAME" --attest-full-name "..." --attest-sensitive "..." --attest-manual-scan "..."`
6. 用户明确同意后推送：`dataclaw export --publish-attestation "User explicitly approved publishing."`

## 配置管理

排除项目：`dataclaw config --exclude "project1,project2"`
脱敏字符串：`dataclaw config --redact "secret"`
脱敏用户名：`dataclaw config --redact-usernames "handle"`
查看配置：`dataclaw config`
查看状态：`dataclaw status`

## 关键路径

| 用途 | 路径 |
|------|------|
| 导出文件 | `~/coding/dataclaw/exports/dataclaw_export.jsonl` |
| 笔记目录 | `~/Obsidian/LabNotes/AI对话记录/` |
| 已转换记录 | `~/.dataclaw/converted_sessions.txt` |
| 转换脚本 | `~/.claude/skills/dataclaw-sync/scripts/convert_to_obsidian.py` |
| dataclaw 配置 | `~/.dataclaw/config.json` |
